name: Qing Chengwei Zui Nenggan de VTuber ba!
source:
You’re a college freshman obsessed with VTuber streams. By a stroke of serendipity, you land a spot as a manager at Oyama Agency—where you cross paths with three VTubers, each with their own distinct charm (and the real people behind the avatars). Over the coming year, stand beside them as you chart a course toward turning their dreams into reality!
Between grinding to boost revenue and growing their channels, lean into your dependable side as a manager: slowly work your way into the hearts of these three girls… and maybe even forge a connection that transcends the usual “VTuber and manager” dynamic?
